scope: fixed synthetic observation benchmark; no empirical data, physical inverse, tracker edit, or parameter retuning

input_design.question: With identical latent events, how does dimming before detection change unconditional track coverage and observed lifetime compared with rescaling after tracking?
input_design.rationale: Distinct local observation benchmark explicitly permitted by DASC decision; avoids another inaccessible-data search and does not reopen biological mechanism test.

fixed_design.noise_coupling: Same Gaussian read-noise array for paired gains for each latent event/seed. No shot noise, bleaching, motion, crowding or biological model.
fixed_design.tracker: validation.tracking.run_tracking unchanged, gate_px=4,max_gap=0,min_track_len=4; existing detector defaults including25 absolute and0.30relative gate
fixed_design.post_tracking_comparator: Retain gain1 tracks and multiply extracted raw/background-subtracted intensities only; identities/frame supports do not change. No retracking.
metrics: GT events ever matched out of fixed45
matched GT frame coverage over fixed1440 latent-event frames
per-event observed span and matched-frame coverage; missing event has0 coverage, span absent notzero biological duration
conditional coverage restricted to true noiseless center intensity >=25, both numerator/denominator restricted to same eligible GT frames
false positive points outside3px or outside latent presence, fragmentation per event
paired summary per gain; all individual event rows retained

validation: Identical latent geometry/durations/noise across paired gains
Zero-gain/no-event negative control with same noise model
High-SNR noise-free control detects full deliberately above-threshold envelope
Explicit fixed-denominator arithmetic and missing-event handling
Independent review of implementation and results; no retuning gains/windows after results
input_design.stop_condition: One reviewed synthetic observation benchmark or precise implementation failure; no empirical calibration, DASC cluster claim, physical inverse or tracker refactor.

matching_definition: retained tracker point is matched only if within 3 px of center and within the event presence interval; union is used across fragments
span_definition: inclusive first-to-last matched frame in the union across fragments; null for missing events
post_tracking_rescale_definition: copy gain=1 retained supports/IDs and rescale extracted intensities after tracking only; comparator cannot change supports
